payload.author: claude
payload.body: Shipped native WS sync telemetry on Android: FrickSyncSocket now takes an optional FrickClientTelemetryRuntime (defaults to Noop) and FrickClient.connectSync threads its runtime through. Emits client span 'WebSocket /_frick/sync' (network.protocol.name/url.path/frick.schema_id/frick.schema_revision/frick.authenticated), finished on close with ok|error + frick.ws.close_code/close_category; per-frame sent/received counters labelled by kind; frick.client.ws.connection.duration_ms histogram on close — parity with TS runtime.ts and Swift FR-74. New FrickSyncSocketTelemetryTest. Gate green: pnpm typecheck exit 0, :frick:testDebugUnitTest BUILD SUCCESSFUL.
